_verified: pip install tile-match-gym. Runs via the default gym backend for display+logging. NOT naturally keyboard-playable: action_space is Discrete(84) (choose a tile swap), so there is no arrow-key mapping -- a human would need a pointer/selection input mode.

curriculum._note: Constructor requires board kwargs (passed via make_kwargs). render_mode=rgb_array -> (324,273,3). obs is an OrderedDict. Discrete(84) swap actions -> no keyboard keymap.
